{{Quote|Go to the warehouse and see what this informant has to say. I do not expect any danger, as very few people know about this meeting, but be prepared for anything just in case.|[[Brantlee Spondoon]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:HGtII" />}}
A '''warehouse''' in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core]] [[Planet/Legends|World]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] was in operation during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:HGtII" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Brantlee Spondoon]], the assistant to [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Diktat]] [[Daclif Gallamby]] tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with traveling to the warehouse to meet with a government [[Information broker/Legends|informant]]. The spacer discovered that the informant had been savagely attacked by [[Rogue CorSec]] criminals after they took over the building. The informant died but his information allowed to discover a plot created by the Rogue CorSecs to discredit the Diktat and the Corellian government.<ref name="SWG:HGtII" />

==Behind the scenes==
The warehouse in Coronet was a location in the video game ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:HGtII" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>

The warehouse was added to the game with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> It was part of questline that featured the Rogue CorSec plot against the Diktat.<ref name="SWG:HGtII" /> This story arc was later slightly revamped with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 27 Notes for February 15th, 2006|Publish 27]]", on [[February 15]], [[2006]],<ref name="SonyForumsCite-What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th">{{SonyForumsCite|url=swg/board/message?board.id=Announcements&message.id=3077&jump=true|text=What's On Deck! Publish 28 Update Notes, April 26th}}</ref> as the questline was integrated into the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]," the main questline in the game.<ref name="SWG:HGtII" />
